title: Looking for Artist for Character Art Cards
content:
LOOKING FOR AN ARTIST!

I’m looking for an artist to work with one of my author clients on character art cards for multiple books. We have quite a few projects in the works, so I’d love to connect with someone interested in an ongoing working relationship and multiple commissions!

Here’s what we’re looking for:
- Character art/cards for books
- Budget: Under $100 per art piece
- Multiple pieces across multiple books
- Must be available to start now!
- NO AI-GENERATED ART. Human artists only, please!

If you’re an artist whose style might be a good fit, please drop your portfolio or commission sheet in the comments, along with your pricing and current availability!

If you know an artist who might be interested, please tag them or share this post.

We’d love to find someone whose art we can keep coming back to as these projects grow!

title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content:
Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator

We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds.

Quality level matching the attached characters

Requirements:
- Japanese anime art style (see attached images)
- Experience with 2D game character art
- Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors)
- work needs to match the quality of the attached examples (especially the coloring)

To apply: Send your portfolio.
Feel free to reach out!

title: Hiring artist for fantasy character postcard illustrations
content:
If this isn't appropriate here, I understand, and please delete. I'm a regular reader here but also an author now looking to hire an artist who shuns AI to create (for pay, of course) character images from one of my recent books; I want to turn them into postcards to hand out at conventions and book events. If you can do fantasy character art, please reach out by DM and send me your URL/gallery so I can see if we sync up! Particular interest in BIPOC artists, but not restricted to that.

EDIT TO ADD: Thanks to all of you! I will absolutely reach back if I think there's a good visual fit for what I'm hoping for. You all have such wonderful work it's hard to choose!

(Admin note: budget not specified; author open to discussing fair rates)
